questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Viksit Bharat Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025, which replaced the MGNREGA:
1. It guarantees 125 days of wage employment per year to rural households.
2. In general, the Centre and the States share its cost in the ratio 60:40.
3. It is wholly funded by the Union Government.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Act raised the guarantee from 100 to 125 days and made the scheme centrally sponsored with a 60:40 Centre-State split (90:10 for hill and North-Eastern States), whereas the MGNREGA wages were fully Central. Statement 3 is therefore wrong.
questions.s: LiveLaw, 'Parliament passes VB-G RAM G Bill', Dec 2025; The Week, 21 Dec 2025

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: Under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025, States must notify in advance a period of 60 days during which works under the scheme are not started.
Statement-II: The provision is meant to keep agricultural labour available during peak sowing and harvesting seasons.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: Because wage works compete with farm work for the same labour, a notified pause protects farmers during the busiest weeks. States can fix different periods for different areas according to local farming patterns.
questions.s: LiveLaw, Dec 2025

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the PM POSHAN scheme:
1. The Mid Day Meal programme began in 1995 as a national programme for primary education.
2. A Supreme Court order in 2001 made it mandatory to serve cooked meals in government and aided primary schools.
3. It was renamed PM POSHAN in 2021.
4. It is administered by the Ministry of Women and Child Development.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The national programme started on 15 August 1995, the Court's 2001 order (PUCL case) turned it into a cooked-meal entitlement, and the 2021 renaming extended it to pre-primary (Bal Vatika) classes. It is run by the Ministry of Education, so statement 4 is wrong.
questions.s: Ministry of Education, PM POSHAN; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Poverty and Social Sectors)

questions.q:
Arrange the following rights-based laws in chronological order:
1. National Food Security Act
2. Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act
3. Right to Information Act
4. National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
questions.e: The RTI Act (June 2005) was followed by the NREGA (September 2005), the RTE Act (2009) and the National Food Security Act (2013).
questions.s: Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Poverty and Social Sectors)

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM):
1. It was restructured from the Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana.
2. It is implemented by the Ministry of Women and Child Development.
3. It builds self-help groups of poor women and federates them at village and higher levels.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: DAY-NRLM (Aajeevika, 2011) replaced SGSY and is a Ministry of Rural Development programme, so statement 2 is wrong. Its core is SHG mobilisation and federation of rural poor women.
questions.s: Ministry of Rural Development; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G):
1. It was formed by restructuring the Indira Awaas Yojana.
2. Unit assistance is Rs 1.20 lakh in plain areas and Rs 1.30 lakh in North-Eastern and hill States.
3. It is wholly funded by the Union Government.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: PMAY-G (April 2016) replaced the IAY with a higher unit assistance and SECC-based selection. Funding is shared between the Centre and States, with States bearing a matching share, so statement 3 is wrong.
questions.s: Ministry of Rural Development; Cabinet decision, Aug 2024

questions.q: In August 2024 the Union Cabinet approved PMAY-Urban 2.0 and continuation of PMAY-Gramin up to 2028-29. They aim to assist respectively
o: 1 crore urban families and about 3 crore additional rural houses
1 crore urban families and about 2 crore additional rural houses
2 crore urban families and about 1 crore additional rural houses
5 crore urban families and about 2 crore additional rural houses
questions.e: PMAY-U 2.0 targets one crore urban poor and middle-class families, while PMAY-G adds about two crore more houses over FY 2024-25 to 2028-29, with unit assistance unchanged at Rs 1.20 lakh and Rs 1.30 lakh.
questions.s: PIB / PMO Cabinet decisions, Aug 2024

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY):
1. It was launched in December 2000.
2. Its objective is to provide all-weather road connectivity to unconnected rural habitations.
3. It is implemented by the Ministry of Panchayati Raj.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: PMGSY was launched on 25 December 2000 by the Ministry of Rural Development, which implements it through the National Rural Infrastructure Development Agency. Panchayati Raj has no role in running it.
questions.s: Ministry of Rural Development; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Saansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (SAGY):
1. Each Member of Parliament is to develop a village as a model village.
2. A separate fund is allocated for the scheme.
3. Rajya Sabha members can choose a village in any district of the State from which they are elected.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: SAGY (launched 11 October 2014) works through convergence of existing schemes and MPLADS, and has no separate fund, so statement 2 is wrong. Rajya Sabha members choose from their State, while nominated members may choose any district in the country.
questions.s: Ministry of Rural Development; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy

questions.q:
Arrange the following sanitation programmes in chronological order:
1. Total Sanitation Campaign
2. Swachh Bharat Mission
3. Central Rural Sanitation Programme
4. Nirmal Bharat Abhiyan
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
questions.e: The Central Rural Sanitation Programme began in 1986, the Total Sanitation Campaign in 1999, Nirmal Bharat Abhiyan in 2012 and Swachh Bharat Mission on 2 October 2014.
questions.s: Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Poverty and Social Sectors); Ministry of Jal Shakti

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Jal Jeevan Mission:
1. It aims to provide a functional household tap connection to every rural household.
2. It is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development.
3. In March 2026 the Union Cabinet extended its period up to December 2028.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: JJM (announced 15 August 2019) is run by the Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation in the Ministry of Jal Shakti, not Rural Development. The Cabinet approved an extension to December 2028 with a revamped outlay in March 2026.
questions.s: PIB / PMO, Cabinet approves extension of Jal Jeevan Mission up to December 2028, March 2026

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Atal Bhujal Yojana:
1. It promotes community-led groundwater management.
2. It covers water-stressed areas in seven States.
3. It is meant only for coastal States facing salinity ingress.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The scheme (December 2019, Ministry of Jal Shakti) targets over-exploited areas in Gujarat, Haryana, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh. These include many inland States, so statement 3 is wrong.
questions.s: Ministry of Jal Shakti, Atal Bhujal Yojana

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP):
1. It was launched in 1995.
2. It includes the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme for those below the poverty line aged 60 years and above.
3. It includes the National Family Benefit Scheme, a lump-sum payment on the death of the primary breadwinner of a poor family.
4. It is a State sector scheme with no Central funding.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: NSAP (15 August 1995) gives Central assistance for social security to the poor, including old-age, widow and disability pensions and a family benefit. It is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, so statement 4 is wrong.
questions.s: Ministry of Rural Development, NSAP; Laxmikanth Ch on Directive Principles for context

questions.q:
Match the scheme with the Ministry that administers it:
List-I (Scheme)
A. SVAMITVA
B. DAY-NRLM
C. PM-JANMAN
D. Poshan Abhiyaan
List-II (Ministry)
1. Ministry of Panchayati Raj
2. Ministry of Rural Development
3. Ministry of Tribal Affairs
4. Ministry of Women and Child Development
questions.e: SVAMITVA maps village land with drones and issues property cards under Panchayati Raj; DAY-NRLM is the rural livelihoods mission; PM-JANMAN serves particularly vulnerable tribal groups; Poshan Abhiyaan is a WCD nutrition mission.
questions.s: Respective ministries; PIB

questions.q: The Vibrant Villages Programme, approved in 2023, is implemented by which one of the following?
questions.e: It is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme for development of border villages along the northern border, to improve livelihoods and curb out-migration. It sits with the MHA, which also oversees border management.
questions.s: PIB, Cabinet decision Feb 2023

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: The Aspirational Districts Programme uses competition among districts as one of its guiding principles.
Statement-II: Districts are publicly ranked on incremental progress across key indicators in five themes, including health and nutrition, education and agriculture.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: NITI Aayog's programme (January 2018) rests on convergence, collaboration and competition. The ranking is based on improvement (delta ranking), not absolute levels, which rewards districts that start from low bases.
questions.s: NITI Aayog, Aspirational Districts Programme

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the National Food Security Act, 2013:
1. It covers up to 75 per cent of the rural and 50 per cent of the urban population.
2. Priority households receive rice at Rs 1, wheat at Rs 2 and coarse grains at Rs 3 per kg.
3. Each Antyodaya Anna Yojana household receives 5 kg of foodgrains per person per month.
4. The eldest woman of the household aged 18 years or above is the head of the household for issuing ration cards.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The prices are the other way round: rice Rs 3, wheat Rs 2 and coarse grains Re 1 per kg. AAY households get 35 kg per household per month, not per person. Coverage figures and the eldest-woman rule are correct.
questions.s: Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Poverty and Social Sectors); NFSA 2013

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY):
1. It was introduced in 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic.
2. In late 2023 the Cabinet approved free foodgrains for about 81.35 crore beneficiaries under the NFSA for five years from January 2024.
3. It replaced the National Food Security Act, 2013.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: PMGKAY gave extra free grain during the pandemic and was later merged with NFSA entitlements. It works through the Act and did not replace it, so statement 3 is wrong.
questions.s: PIB / PMO, Cabinet decision, Nov 2023

questions.q: The Integrated Child Development Services scheme, launched on 2 October 1975, provides how many services?
questions.e: The six services are supplementary nutrition, pre-school non-formal education, nutrition and health education, immunisation, health check-up and referral services, delivered through anganwadi centres.
questions.s: Ministry of Women and Child Development; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding POSHAN Abhiyaan:
1. It was launched in March 2018 from Jhunjhunu, Rajasthan.
2. It aims to reduce stunting, undernutrition, anaemia and low birth weight.
3. It is run by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: POSHAN (Prime Minister's Overarching Scheme for Holistic Nutrition) is a multi-ministry mission led by the Ministry of Women and Child Development, with technology and convergence at its centre. Statement 3 is wrong.
questions.s: Ministry of Women and Child Development

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding Ayushman Bharat-Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY):
1. It was launched in September 2018.
2. It offers health cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.
3. It limits coverage to families of at most five members.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: AB PM-JAY (23 September 2018) is a cashless scheme implemented by the National Health Authority, with eligibility based on SECC deprivation and occupational criteria. It has no cap on family size or age, so statement 3 is wrong.
questions.s: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare; National Health Authority

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the expansion of AB PM-JAY to senior citizens from October 2024:
1. All citizens aged 70 years and above are eligible irrespective of income.
2. Each elderly person in a household gets a separate cover of Rs 5 lakh.
3. Eligible beneficiaries have to register and complete eKYC.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Rs 5 lakh cover is per household per year and is shared when several elderly people live together, so statement 2 is wrong. The Vay Vandana card is issued after registration and eKYC.
questions.s: Business Today, 30 Oct 2024; MoHFW

questions.q: Accredited Social Health Activists (ASHAs) were introduced under which one of the following?
o: Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres
questions.e: ASHA, a community health volunteer chosen from the village (about one per 1,000 population), is a key link of the NRHM launched in 2005, now part of the National Health Mission.
questions.s: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy

questions.q:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Scheme)
A. Janani Suraksha Yojana
B. Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram
C. Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan
D. Mission Indradhanush
List-II (Feature)
1. Cash incentive for institutional delivery
2. Free drop-back, diagnostics and drugs for pregnant women and sick newborns
3. Free antenatal check-up on the 9th of every month
4. Immunisation against vaccine-preventable diseases
questions.e: JSY (2005) is a conditional cash transfer, JSSK (2011) makes care free of cost, PMSMA (2016) gives a fixed day for antenatal care, and Mission Indradhanush (December 2014) raises immunisation coverage.
questions.s: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy
questions.h: PMSMA: 9th of every month, like nine months of pregnancy

questions.q: When Mission Indradhanush was launched in December 2014, it aimed to immunise children against how many vaccine-preventable diseases?
questions.e: The original seven diseases were diphtheria, whooping cough, tetanus, polio, tuberculosis, measles and hepatitis B. Later phases (Intensified Mission Indradhanush) added more vaccines.
questions.s: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, PIB

questions.q: The 'four Ds' screened under the Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram are
o: dental caries, deafness, dyslexia and diabetes
defects at birth, deficiencies, diseases and developmental delays including disabilities
questions.e: RBSK (2013) provides early identification and free treatment for children from birth to 18 years across these four categories through mobile health teams and district early intervention centres.
questions.s: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, RBSK

questions.q: The Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) number created under the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission is a
questions.e: ABHA is a 14-digit health ID that links a person's digital health records. The 12-digit number is Aadhaar, and it is not the same as the ABHA.
questions.s: National Health Authority, ABDM

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009:
1. It operationalises Article 21A inserted by the 86th Constitutional Amendment.
2. It requires all schools, including government schools, to reserve 25 per cent seats for disadvantaged children.
3. The 2019 amendment allows States to hold back a child in Class V and VIII after a regular examination and remedial teaching.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The 25 per cent reservation applies to private unaided and specified-category schools, not government schools, so statement 2 is wrong. The 2019 amendment ended the blanket no-detention policy for Classes V and VIII.
questions.s: Laxmikanth (Fundamental Rights and DPSP chapters); Ministry of Education

questions.q: Samagra Shiksha, launched in 2018, subsumed which of the following?
o: Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan, Rashtriya Madhyamik Shiksha Abhiyan and Teacher Education
Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan, Mid Day Meal and Adult Education
Mid Day Meal, Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya and Navodaya Vidyalaya
Rashtriya Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan and National Skill Development Mission
questions.e: Samagra Shiksha treats school education from pre-school to Class 12 as a continuum, merging the elementary (SSA), secondary (RMSA) and teacher education schemes under one umbrella.
questions.s: Ministry of Education

questions.q: The PM SHRI Schools scheme, approved in 2022, is meant to
o: provide free residential schooling to every child below six years
replace Kendriya Vidyalayas with private schools
develop over 14,500 schools as exemplars showcasing the National Education Policy 2020
questions.e: PM Schools for Rising India are existing schools of the Centre, States and local bodies that are upgraded as models of NEP implementation, with green and inclusive features.
questions.s: PIB, Cabinet decision, Sept 2022

questions.q: NIPUN Bharat, launched in 2021, aims to ensure that every child acquires
o: foundational literacy and numeracy by the end of Grade 3 by 2026-27
English proficiency by the end of Grade 5 by 2024
vocational training by the end of Grade 10 by 2025
digital skills by the end of Grade 8 by 2030
questions.e: The National Initiative for Proficiency in Reading with Understanding and Numeracy sits under Samagra Shiksha and supports the NEP 2020 goal of universal foundational learning.
questions.s: Ministry of Education, NIPUN Bharat

questions.q: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao, launched in January 2015 from Panipat, is a joint initiative of the Ministries of
o: Health and Family Welfare, Home Affairs, and Labour
Women and Child Development, Health and Family Welfare, and Education
Women and Child Development, Rural Development, and Social Justice
questions.e: BBBP was started to address the declining Child Sex Ratio and promote the education of girls, with the Women and Child Development ministry as the nodal ministry.
questions.s: Ministry of Women and Child Development

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: The Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana is expected to reduce health hazards from indoor air pollution among poor households.
Statement-II: The scheme provides deposit-free LPG connections in the name of adult women of poor households, which replaces firewood and dung cakes as cooking fuel.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: Cooking on biomass in poorly ventilated homes exposes women and children to smoke. Giving poor households clean LPG removes the source, which explains the expected health gain. The scheme was launched from Ballia in May 2016.
questions.s: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

questions.q: The National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) is
o: a wholly owned subsidiary of the Ministry of Labour and Employment
a not-for-profit public limited company with 49 per cent government and 51 per cent private sector shareholding
a constitutional body under the Eighth Schedule
a statutory body created by the National Skill Development Act
questions.e: NSDC (2008-09) was set up as a public-private partnership under the Companies Act to catalyse private-sector skills training, and now operates under the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.
questions.s: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding PM-JANMAN:
1. It targets Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups.
2. It aims to provide basic facilities such as housing, roads, electricity and drinking water to their habitations.
3. It is implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Pradhan Mantri Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (November 2023) covers 75 PVTG communities, and is led by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, so statement 3 is wrong.
questions.s: PIB, Ministry of Tribal Affairs

questions.q: The Accessible India Campaign (Sugamya Bharat Abhiyan) focuses on all of the following EXCEPT
o: accessibility of the information and communication technology ecosystem
questions.e: The campaign launched on 3 December 2015 by the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities has three verticals: built environment, transport and ICT. Education is handled by other schemes.
questions.s: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities

questions.q:
With reference to the urban livelihoods mission DAY-NULM, consider the following statements:
1. It replaced the Swarna Jayanti Shahari Rozgar Yojana.
2. It includes shelters for the urban homeless.
3. It is administered by the Ministry of Labour and Employment.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: NULM (2013) integrated urban poverty alleviation efforts such as skills, self-employment, shelters and street vendor support. It sits with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, so statement 3 is wrong.
questions.s: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Smart Cities Mission:
1. It was launched in June 2015 and selected 100 cities through a City Challenge Competition.
2. Each city set up a Special Purpose Vehicle to implement projects.
3. It is funded wholly by the State Governments.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Mission combined area-based and pan-city development, with the Centre and States/ULBs sharing funds and an SPV in each city. It was not wholly State-funded.
questions.s: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy

questions.q:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I (Urban Mission)
A. Smart Cities Mission
B. AMRUT
C. HRIDAY
D. Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban
List-II (Focus)
1. Area-based and pan-city smart solutions
2. Basic urban infrastructure such as water supply and sewerage
3. Heritage city development
4. Sanitation and solid waste management
questions.e: All except SBM-U (2 October 2014) were launched in 2015. AMRUT (500 cities) focuses on water supply, sewerage and urban transport, and HRIDAY covered 12 heritage cities.
questions.s: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

questions.q:
Arrange the following urban programmes in chronological order:
1. Rajiv Awas Yojana
2. Jawaharlal Nehru National Urban Renewal Mission
3. Swachh Bharat Mission-Urban
4. Smart Cities Mission
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
questions.e: JNNURM began in December 2005, Rajiv Awas Yojana in 2011, SBM-Urban in October 2014 and Smart Cities in June 2015.
questions.s: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

questions.q: Under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, the central financial assistance for rooftop solar systems of 3 kW and above is up to
questions.e: The scheme, run by MNRE, aims to light up one crore households with rooftop solar; assistance rises from Rs 30,000 (1 kW) to Rs 60,000 (2 kW) and is capped at Rs 78,000.
questions.s: MNRE; Drishti IAS scheme note

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Jawaharlal Nehru National Urban Renewal Mission (JNNURM):
1. It was launched in December 2005.
2. It had a sub-mission on Urban Infrastructure and Governance.
3. It had a sub-mission on Basic Services to the Urban Poor.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: JNNURM was the first large national urban mission, with UIG and BSUP as its main sub-missions for bigger cities, and companion programmes for small and medium towns. It was succeeded in 2015 by AMRUT and other missions.
questions.s: Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Infrastructure); Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
Statement-I: The Janani Suraksha Yojana has helped to raise the share of births taking place in health facilities.
Statement-II: The scheme gives a cash incentive to mothers who deliver in a government or accredited health facility.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II explains Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II does not explain Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
questions.e: A conditional cash transfer reduces the cost of choosing a facility over home birth, so more mothers opt for institutional delivery. This is the aim of JSY (2005) under the NRHM.
questions.s: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy

questions.q:
Consider the following statements regarding the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban (PMAY-U) launched in 2015:
1. It was launched in June 2015 with the goal of Housing for All.
2. It had a Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme vertical.
3. A male head of the family must be the sole owner of the house.
4. Only families from the Economically Weaker Section are eligible under all verticals.
How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The mission (25 June 2015) had four verticals, including CLSS for EWS, LIG and MIG buyers. House ownership was to be in the name of a female member or jointly, so statement 3 is wrong, and statement 4 is wrong because CLSS covered LIG and MIG too.
questions.s: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

questions.q: The Rashtriya Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan (RUSA), launched in 2013, was a Centrally Sponsored Scheme meant to
o: fund Central universities and IITs only
fund State public universities and colleges to improve access, equity and quality in higher education
provide student loans through nationalised banks
questions.e: RUSA funds State higher education institutions in return for governance and academic reforms. It has since been continued as PM-USHA.
questions.s: Ministry of Education

questions.q: The pilot Self Help Group-Bank Linkage Programme was launched by NABARD in
questions.e: NABARD (founded 1982) began the SHG-Bank Linkage pilot in 1992; it later became the main channel for credit to self-help groups and a base for the NRLM approach.
questions.s: NABARD; Ramesh Singh, Indian Economy (Banking)

questions.q: The Namo Drone Didi scheme is meant to
o: distribute drones to police for border surveillance
train women pilots for commercial airlines
provide drones to women self-help groups for agricultural services
install drones for postal delivery in cities
questions.e: The scheme, approved in 2023, equips women SHGs with agricultural drones for spraying and other services to give them a sustainable income source.
questions.s: PIB, Cabinet decision, Nov 2023

questions.q: The SVAMITVA scheme aims to
o: provide health cards for rural households
map inhabited rural land using drones and give property cards to owners
questions.e: SVAMITVA (April 2020, Ministry of Panchayati Raj) uses drone surveys to record abadi land, giving owners legal documents that can serve as collateral for bank credit.
questions.s: Ministry of Panchayati Raj

questions.q: The Pradhan Mantri Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyan aims to make how many rural households digitally literate?
questions.e: PMGDISHA, under MeitY, targets one member per eligible rural household in the 14 to 60 age group, covering about 6 crore households.
questions.s: MeitY, PMGDISHA

questions.q: The National Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission, launched in July 2023, aims to eliminate the disease as a public health problem by
questions.e: The mission targets screening and counselling of the population, particularly tribal areas, with the goal of elimination by 2047. It was launched from Shahdol in Madhya Pradesh.
questions.s: PIB, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, 1 July 2023
